name: one-leg-smith-machine-seated-calf-raise.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the one-leg smith machine seated calf raise by placing a flat bench in the smith machine and putting a step or calf Block under the bar.
2. Lower the bar and add the weight you want to use.
3. Sit on the end of the bench with your feet and knees together and place your left foot on the block with the balls of your feet on the edge.
4. Take the bar off the rack and rest it on your left thigh.
5. Allow your heel to drop as far as possible without touching the floor. This is the exerting position.
6. Execute the movement by raising your heel up as far as possible.
7. Squeeze the calf muscle, and then slowly lower your heel back to the starting position.
8. Repeat for desired reps, and then repeat on the right leg.
